<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_SupplierSelection" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/supplier-selection">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_RFP" name="Request for proposals"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Proposal" name="Supplier proposal"/>
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_SupplierSelection">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Company" name="Company" processRef="Process_SupplierSelection"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Suppliers" name="Suppliers"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_RFP" name="Issue RFP" sourceRef="Task_IssueRFP" targetRef="Participant_Suppliers" messageRef="Message_RFP"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Proposal" name="Submit proposals" sourceRef="Participant_Suppliers" targetRef="Task_ReceiveProposals" messageRef="Message_Proposal"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_SupplierSelection" name="Select and onboard supplier" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_NeedIdentified" name="Need for a new supplier identified">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_IssueRFP</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_IssueRFP" name="Issue request for proposals" messageRef="Message_RFP">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_IssueRFP</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_IssueRFP_ReceiveProposals</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveProposals" name="Receive supplier responses" messageRef="Message_Proposal">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_IssueRFP_ReceiveProposals</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReceiveProposals_Evaluate</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EvaluateProposals" name="Evaluate proposals based on cost, quality, and delivery time">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReceiveProposals_Evaluate</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Evaluate_AdditionalAssessment</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AdditionalAssessment" name="Conduct additional supplier assessment?" default="Flow_Assessment_Skip">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Evaluate_AdditionalAssessment</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Assessment_Conduct</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Assessment_Skip</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConductAssessment" name="Conduct site visits or interviews with suppliers">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Assessment_Conduct</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ConductAssessment_Merge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AssessmentMerge" name="Continue assessment">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ConductAssessment_Merge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Assessment_Skip</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AssessmentMerge_Analyze</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Analyze" name="Analyze proposals and assessment results">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AssessmentMerge_Analyze</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Analyze_Select</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectSupplier" name="Select supplier">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Analyze_Select</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Select_Negotiate</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Negotiate" name="Negotiate contract terms">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Select_Negotiate</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Negotiate_Agree</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AgreeTerms" name="Agree contract terms">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Negotiate_Agree</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Agree_Sign</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SignContract" name="Sign contract">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Agree_Sign</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Sign_Parallel</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_FinalSplit" name="Complete onboarding and contract execution">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Sign_Parallel</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FinalSplit_Onboard</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FinalSplit_Execute</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_OnboardSupplier" name="Officially onboard supplier">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FinalSplit_Onboard</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Onboard_FinalJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ExecuteContract" name="Execute contract">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FinalSplit_Execute</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Execute_FinalJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_FinalJoin" name="Onboarding and contract execution complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Onboard_FinalJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Execute_FinalJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FinalJoin_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Complete" name="Supplier onboarded and contract executed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FinalJoin_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_IssueRFP" sourceRef="StartEvent_NeedIdentified" targetRef="Task_IssueRFP"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IssueRFP_ReceiveProposals" sourceRef="Task_IssueRFP" targetRef="Task_ReceiveProposals"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReceiveProposals_Evaluate" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveProposals" targetRef="Task_EvaluateProposals"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Evaluate_AdditionalAssessment" sourceRef="Task_EvaluateProposals" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalAssessment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Assessment_Conduct" name="Conduct visits or interviews" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalAssessment" targetRef="Task_ConductAssessment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Assessment_Skip" name="No additional assessment" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalAssessment" targetRef="Gateway_AssessmentMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ConductAssessment_Merge" sourceRef="Task_ConductAssessment" targetRef="Gateway_AssessmentMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AssessmentMerge_Analyze" sourceRef="Gateway_AssessmentMerge" targetRef="Task_Analyze"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Analyze_Select" sourceRef="Task_Analyze" targetRef="Task_SelectSupplier"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Select_Negotiate" sourceRef="Task_SelectSupplier" targetRef="Task_Negotiate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Negotiate_Agree" sourceRef="Task_Negotiate" targetRef="Task_AgreeTerms"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agree_Sign" sourceRef="Task_AgreeTerms" targetRef="Task_SignContract"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Sign_Parallel" sourceRef="Task_SignContract" targetRef="Gateway_FinalSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FinalSplit_Onboard" sourceRef="Gateway_FinalSplit" targetRef="Task_OnboardSupplier"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FinalSplit_Execute" sourceRef="Gateway_FinalSplit" targetRef="Task_ExecuteContract"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Onboard_FinalJoin" sourceRef="Task_OnboardSupplier" targetRef="Gateway_FinalJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Execute_FinalJoin" sourceRef="Task_ExecuteContract" targetRef="Gateway_FinalJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FinalJoin_End" sourceRef="Gateway_FinalJoin" targetRef="EndEvent_Complete"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
